title: 30-Inch Towel Bar (Center-To-Center) – Que New Collection, Solid Brass, Wall Mount, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping towels over doors and counters—this 30-inch wall-mounted towel bar keeps bath towels hung neatly, dry, and ready when you need them.

  • Clear, organized towel storage with a straight bar design sized for everyday bathroom use
  • Enduring, rust-resistant construction made from solid brass
  • Clean, finished installation with concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Coordinated look as part of the Que New collection—ideal for matching Que New, transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware

  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mount
  • Assembly required: No

  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
